title: LANGUAGE MODELS ARE HOMER SIMPSON! Safety Re-Alignment of Fine-tuned Language Models through Task Arithmetic
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measures the model's propensity to generate harmful content related to religious intolerance, such as creating fake news stories that portray a religious group in a negative light.
findings: The paper finds that fine-tuning language models can compromise their safety, increasing their propensity to generate harmful content related to religious intolerance (as part of a broader 'Hate/Harass/Violence' category). The proposed method, RESTA, was shown to effectively restore the model's safety guardrails and reduce the generation of such harmful content across multiple languages.
